messages:
olivia (solutions): FinBank POC seeing spikes of 429s + occasional streaming disconnects via corporate proxy. using TS SDK in node 18.

mark (sales): streaming or single requests? any request ids?

olivia (solutions): streaming. they pasted logs with NGHTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR and 'socket hang up' during stream. also a few 504s after ~60s.

dan (eng): sounds like proxy not handling HTTP/2 and dropping long-lived connections. did they run curl with --no-http2?

tara (sdks): recommend forcing http1, keepAlive agent, smaller socket pool. sample code: 

```js
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 6 });
const client = new Redwood({ agent, forceHttp1: true, maxRetries: 2 });
await client.stream({ model: 'gpt-open-2', input: 'test' });
```

sec-bot: sending SOC2 pack and security questionnaire to FinBank.

dan (eng): proxy 504 after 60s => idle timeout. short-term: send heartbeat comments between chunks or reduce chunk interval. also add retry jitter to avoid thundering herd.

olivia (solutions): I'll send the snippets + ask for REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG logs and X-Request-Id. they also asked if we can run them on Dedicated for POC.

mark (sales): we can offer a 30-day Dedicated eval. I'll start paperwork.

tara (sdks): if forcing http1 doesn't fix NGHTTP2, capture SDK debug output and we will investigate client parsing.

dan (eng): we can also spin up a short Dedicated pool in their region to bypass proxy for streaming.

olivia (solutions): plan: 1) send Node + curl repro + debug env 2) request ids 3) propose Dedicated eval 4) security pack. will update after tests.
